answer.reason: The question asks for the December 2024 (month 3 of Q4) private-sector employment for NAICS 23 Construction in Missouri from the BLS QCEW 2024 Q4 statewide file. Construction employment in Missouri runs on the order of 150,000–170,000 covered jobs, with a seasonal peak in Q3 and a moderate decline through Q4. A December figure of 164,268 fits that seasonal pattern, whereas 146,827 would imply an implausibly steep (~13%) drop from the summer peak for December, a level more typical of the late-winter trough. This also matches the supplied draft answer A.
